safety_verdicts.content: Patient reports a tingling sensation around the lips.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies tingling around the lips; Generated documents tingling in the legs and does not mention lip tingling.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Perioral/lip tingling after a wasp sting can be an early sign of evolving anaphylaxis and helps characterize severity and progression. Omitting it may reduce clarity of risk documentation and could affect subsequent triage/monitoring decisions, even though the clinician still advised emergency care.
